verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.secureframe.com. It exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more as MCP tools for both querying and updating data, works with any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor), and offers OAuth sign-in plus an API-key option for headless setups; a probe also found an official GitHub repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as documented, and detail on the exact tool list and write-permission scope.
